entries.title: Accelerating Large Language Models through Partially Linear Feed-Forward Network
entries.mechanism: offline calibrated per-neuron linear replacement and W1-W2 folding; quantized W1 predictor and selective original correction
entries.decision_time: offline calibration then current pre-W1 input predictor and selective exact correction
entries.physical_action: dense D-by-D fold plus online quantized predictor and selected W1/W2 correction
entries.training: offline regression/KDE and GPTQ calibration; original model not finetuned
entries.discriminator: parity even-group exact linear split differs from linear hot-range approximation; count predictor and original fallback

entries.title: How Linear Is a Transformer Feed-Forward Block? Per-Block Linear Recoverability Is Learned, Not Architectural
entries.mechanism: closed-form affine FFN replacement plus fitted rank16 shared bilinear products as residual probe
entries.decision_time: offline paired FFN input/output calibration; current x at inference
entries.physical_action: dense affine x to y plus two x-to-r projections and r-to-output product mix
entries.training: closed-form affine fit and Adam bilinear; optional swapped-only healing
entries.discriminator: rank16 factored residual negative result cannot rule out complete k-dimensional symmetric cross basis; paper/code cost discrepancy

entries.title: Neuron Merging: Compensating for Pruned Neurons
entries.mechanism: ReLU-positive-homogeneity representative neuron merging with downstream weight compensation
entries.physical_action: select retained W1 channels and merge W2 via nonnegative scaling map
entries.training: one-shot data-free, no finetuning in reported examples
entries.discriminator: GELU not positively homogeneous and signed mirror requires separate exact odd-linear compensation
